acceptedAnswer.text: Underpost is the base platform of the ecosystem. It owns the shared CLI, the deployment surface, the PWA delivery model and the operational infrastructure. Object Layer, ItemLedger, Cyberia, CryptoKoyn and Nexodev all run on it.
How the platform is built and why: the engineering history and development journal, laboratory notes of experiments and investigations, and the Architecture Decision Records.
Product features, which each product domain owns; operational procedures, which Nexodev documents; and protocol semantics, which Object Layer owns.

mainEntity.name: What state is the platform in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Engineering and continuous. The platform is under active development and its engineering record grows with it.
